{jobs : ℕ} →
  (m L : ℕ) →
    List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) →
      Scheduling.Assignment → (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ) → Prop
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} {records after : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {E : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ},
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals m L records S E →
    ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (b : ℕ),
      (∀ r ∈ after, r ∈ records) →
        (∀ r ∈ after, ¬(r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧ E r < b)) →
          ∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m after j v → b ≤ S v
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals.future_wide

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      ∀ {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
        {E : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ},
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals m L records S E →
          ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (i : ℕ),
            (∀ (t : ℕ), i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L → ¬Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.IdleEarlier m L S t) →
              ∃ t,
                i * L ≤ t ∧
                  t ≤ (i + 1) * L ∧
                    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideService m records j S (i * L) ((i + 1) * L) ≤
                        (2 * m - 1) * ((i + 1) * L - t + 1) ∧
                      ∀ (u : ℕ),
                        t ≤ u → Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L) ≤ 2 * m - 1
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals.job_wide_cutoff

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {E : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ},
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals m L records S E →
    ∀ r ∈ records,
      ∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))),
        Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = r.owner →
          r.start ≤ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) → ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) < r.stop → E r ≤ S v
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals.layer_after

statement: {jobs work : ℕ} → ℕ → ℕ → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) → Fin jobs → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Prop

statement:
{jobs : ℕ} →
  (m L : ℕ) →
    List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) → Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Prop
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RecordCredit

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} {history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {r s : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)}
  {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {e : ℕ},
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RecordCredit m L history s S e →
    r ∈ history →
      r.owner = s.owner →
        r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 →
          r.start ≤ ↑r.key ∧ ↑r.key < r.stop → S (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key)) = r.time → r.time < e
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RecordCredit.after_wide_key

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      ∀ {history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)}
        {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {e : ℕ},
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RecordCredit m L history r S e →
          r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 →
            ¬Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.IdleEarlier m L S e →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history r.owner S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L)
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RecordCredit.wide_below

statement: {jobs : ℕ} → (m L : ℕ) → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) → Fin jobs → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      2 * (L / 2) = L →
        ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
          (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (e width p : ℕ),
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L history j S e width →
            r.owner = j →
              r.stop - r.start = width →
                e ≤ r.time →
                  width = 2 * m - 1 ∨ width = 1 →
                    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤
                        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
                      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j ≤
                          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j →
                        p =
                            (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j +
                              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j →
                          (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))),
                              Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = j →
                                r.start ≤ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) →
                                  ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) < r.stop → S v ≤ r.time) →
                            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S (r.time + 1)
                              (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L (history ++ [r]) j p S (r.time + 1))
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.after_record

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
  (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (e width : ℕ),
  r.owner ≠ j →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L history j S e width →
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S e width
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.append_other

statement: {jobs work : ℕ} → ℕ → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) → Fin jobs → Fin (jobs * work) → Prop
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
      (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)),
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget m L history P →
        ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L)) (hk : P.closed j ≤ ↑key ∧ ↑key < P.boundary j),
          have hw := ⋯;
          have next := history ++ [P.record hw A j key];
          have t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1;
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget m L next
            (P.advance j key hk ((Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t) ⋯ ⋯)
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.budget_advance

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)),
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget m L history P →
        (∀ r ∈ history, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1) →
          ∀ (j : Fin jobs), m * (List.filter (fun r => decide (r.owner = j)) history).length ≤ P.closed j
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.budget_prefix_work

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m)
  (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget m L history P →
    ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L)),
      P.closed j ≤ ↑key ∧ ↑key < P.boundary j →
        have r := P.record ⋯ A j key;
        r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.budget_record_width

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
  {S T : Scheduling.Assignment} {t : ℕ},
  Scheduling.PastAgreement S T t →
    (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.ChooseWide m L history j S t ↔
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.ChooseWide m L history j T t)
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.chooseWide_congr

statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs)
        (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (e u : ℕ),
        r.owner = j →
          e < u →
            r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1 →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
                (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v → S v < e) →
                  (e / L = u / L →
                      Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - e % L)
                        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j)
                        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j)
                        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S e)) →
                    (e / L = u / L →
                        r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 →
                          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j ≤
                              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ∨
                            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L)) →
                      (e / L = u / L →
                          r.stop - r.start = 1 →
                            (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S e) →
                        Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - u % L)
                          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j)
                          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j)
                          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S u)
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.credit_after_record

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (i c : ℕ)
  (J : Finset (Fin jobs)) (T : Fin jobs → ℕ),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.JobCutoffs m L records S i T →
    J.card ≤ c →
      (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))),
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m records (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v) v →
            i * L ≤ S v → S v < (i + 1) * L → Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v ∈ J) →
        (∀ (u : ℕ),
            i * L ≤ u →
              u ≤ (i + 1) * L →
                (m - c) * ((i + 1) * L - u) ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService m records S u ((i + 1) * L)) →
          ∃ ds, ds.length ≤ c ∧ Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds)
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.cutoffs_passivity

statement: {jobs work : ℕ} → ℕ → ℕ → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) → Fin jobs → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t ≤
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t + (r.stop - r.start)
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_append_le

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  r.owner ≠ j ∨ r.stop - r.start ≠ 2 * m - 1 →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t =
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_append_unchanged

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
  {S T : Scheduling.Assignment} {t : ℕ},
  Scheduling.PastAgreement S T t →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t =
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j T t
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_congr

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) {t u : ℕ},
  t ≤ u →
    t / L = u / L →
      (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v → S v < t) →
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S u =
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_time_closed

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v → S v < t / L * L) →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t = 0
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_zero_closed

statement: ∀ {L t u : ℕ}, 0 < L → t ≤ u → t / L ≠ u / L → t ≤ u / L * L
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epoch_start_after

statement:
∀ (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m),
      ∃ Q records,
        Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
            (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records ∧
          (∃ staticRule,
              Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun ⋯ A staticRule (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q
                records) ∧
            (∀ r ∈ records, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1) ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs),
                  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m records j = L / 2 ∧
                    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount records j = L / 2) ∧
                ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin jobs),
                  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (List.take n records) j ≤
                    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (List.take n records) j
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_balanced_layer_run

statement:
∀ (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m),
  ∃ Q records,
    Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records ∧
      (∃ staticRule,
          Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun ⋯ A staticRule (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q
            records) ∧
        ∀ (u v w : Fin (jobs * (m * L))), (Q.toInstance L ⋯).edge u w → (Q.toInstance L ⋯).edge v w → u = v
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_candidate

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
      {Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)},
      Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records →
        ∃ E, Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedReveals m L records (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯)) E
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_record_reveal_times

statement: {jobs work : ℕ} → ℕ → ℕ → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) → Fin jobs → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    2 * (L / 2) = L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment)
        (t : ℕ),
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
          p =
              (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j +
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j →
            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1 →
              ¬Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.ChooseWide m L history j S t
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    2 * (L / 2) = L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment)
        (t : ℕ),
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
          p =
              (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j +
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j →
            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j < L / 2 →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1 →
                (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L) ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_narrow_threshold

statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
      (P Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L))
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ ↑key ∧ ↑key < P.boundary j),
      (∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) v ≤ A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))) →
        (∀ (i : Fin jobs),
            P.closed i < m * L → A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime ⋯ A i) →
          ∀ (records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))),
            Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A)
                (history ++ [P.record ⋯ A j key])
                (P.advance j key hk
                  ((Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size (history ++ [P.record ⋯ A j key]) P j
                    (A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
                  ⋯ ⋯)
                Q records →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget m L history P →
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit m L history P (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯)) →
                  have hw := ⋯;
                  have next := history ++ [P.record hw A j key];
                  have t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1;
                  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit m L next
                    (P.advance j key hk ((Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t) ⋯ ⋯)
                    (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw))
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.frontierCredit_advance

statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
      (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (t : ℕ),
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j ≤ L / 2 →
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
          P.boundary j =
              (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j +
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j →
            (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size history P j t = 0 ∧ P.boundary j = m * L ∨
              (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size history P j t = 2 * m - 1 ∧
                  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j < L / 2 ∨
                (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size history P j t = 1 ∧
                  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j < Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j

  (j : Fin jobs),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j =
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j + if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 then 1 else 0
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount_append

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work)
  (hw : 0 < work) (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) (j i : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [P.record hw A j key]) i =
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history i + if j = i ∧ P.width j = 2 * m - 1 then 1 else 0
name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount_append_record

statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs) (v : Fin (jobs * work)),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m (history ++ [r]) j v ↔
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v ∨
      Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = j ∧
        r.owner = j ∧
          r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧
            r.start ≤ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) ∧ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) < r.stop

      {v | Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m records (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v) v ∧ S v = t}.card

statement:

        a ≤ S v → S v < b → Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v ∈ J) →

        (∀ (u : ℕ), a ≤ u → u ≤ z → (m - c) * (z - u) ≤ (List.map (fun x => F x u) xs).sum) →

  (K : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ u ≤ t,
      J.graphObservation
          (Scheduling.executionPrefix (Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append J d)) d) u) u =
        K.graphObservation
          (Scheduling.executionPrefix (Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append K d)) d) u) u) →
    Scheduling.executionSlot (Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append J d)) d) t =

  {jobs₂ vertices₂ : ℕ} (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂),
  J.maxFlow ((A.continuation I d).schedule J) ≤ (I.append J d).maxFlow (A.schedule (I.append J d))
name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.continuation_flow_le

statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {jobs vertices T : ℕ} (I J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  I.owner = J.owner →
    I.release = J.release →
      (∀ (u v : Fin vertices), v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v)) →
        (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u) →
          (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u) →
            (∀ t ≤ T, Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule J) t) ∧
              ∀ (v : Fin vertices), A.schedule I v ≤ T → A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v
name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.hidden_replacement

statement:
∀ {m jobs vertices : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (B : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (frontier hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  frontier.Nonempty →
    ∀ (hjob : ∀ u ∈ frontier, ∀ v ∈ hidden, B.owner u = B.owner v)
      (hrank : ∀ u ∈ frontier, ∀ v ∈ hidden, B.rank u < B.rank v),
      ∃ key ∈ frontier,
        have I := B.gate frontier hidden hjob hrank;
        (∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule I v ≤ A.schedule I key) ∧
          ∀ (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices),
            B.owner = J.owner →
              B.release = J.release →
                (∀ (u v : Fin vertices), v ∉ hidden → (B.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v)) →
                  (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ (u = key ∨ u ∈ hidden)) →
                    (∀ t ≤ A.schedule I key,
                        Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule J) t) ∧
                      (∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v) ∧
                        ∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule J v ≤ A.schedule J key
name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.select_hidden_key

statement:

      I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
        J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) →
    Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) (T + 1) = Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule J) (T + 1)
name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.transfer_prefix

statement:

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {c L k : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},

    0 < L →

        I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ j ∈ I.alive S (c * k * L), Scheduling.firstForcingTime c L ↑j = c * k * L

statement:
{jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} →
  Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁ →
    Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂ → ℕ → Scheduling.Instance (jobs₁ + jobs₂) (vertices₁ + vertices₂)
name: Scheduling.Instance.append

statement: {vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} → Scheduling.Assignment → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
name: Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule

statement:
∀ {vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (d : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices₁),
  Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule S T d (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v) = S v
name: Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule_left

statement:
∀ {vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (d : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices₂),
  Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule S T d (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v) = d + T v
name: Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule_right

statement:
∀ {vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (d t : ℕ),
  {v | Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule S T d v = t}.card = {v | S v = t}.card + {v | d + T v = t}.card
name: Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule_slot_card

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {L d : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : Fin jobs₁), L ∣ I.release j) →
    (∀ (j : Fin jobs₂), L ∣ J.release j) → L ∣ d → ∀ (j : Fin (jobs₁ + jobs₂)), L ∣ (I.append J d).release j
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_batched_releases

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {d B : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {T : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.FlowBound S B → J.FlowBound T B → (I.append J d).FlowBound (Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule S T d) B
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_flowBound

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  d ≤ t →
    (I.append J d).graphObservation done t =
      (I.graphObservation done t).merge
        ((J.graphObservation (Scheduling.shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).shift jobs₁ vertices₁ d)
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_graphObservation

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  t < d → (I.append J d).graphObservation done t = I.graphObservation done t
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_graphObservation_before

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  d ≤ t →
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).arrivals =
      (I.graphObservation done t).arrivals ∪
        Finset.image (fun p => (jobs₁ + p.1, d + p.2))
          (J.graphObservation (Scheduling.shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).arrivals
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_arrivals

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  d ≤ t →
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).edges =
      (I.graphObservation done t).edges ∪
        Finset.image (fun p => (vertices₁ + p.1, vertices₁ + p.2))
          (J.graphObservation (Scheduling.shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).edges
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_edges

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  d ≤ t →
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).ready =
      (I.graphObservation done t).ready ∪
        Finset.image (fun x => vertices₁ + x) (J.graphObservation (Scheduling.shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).ready
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_ready

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  d ≤ t →
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).visible =
      (I.graphObservation done t).visible ∪
        Finset.image (fun p => (vertices₁ + p.1, jobs₁ + p.2))
          (J.graphObservation (Scheduling.shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).visible
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_visible

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {m B d : ℕ},
  (∃ S, I.Valid m S ∧ I.FlowBound S B) →
    (∃ T, J.Valid m T ∧ J.FlowBound T B) →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs₁), I.release j + B ≤ d) → ∃ U, (I.append J d).Valid m U ∧ (I.append J d).FlowBound U B
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_offline

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (hm : 0 < m) {B d : ℕ},
  I.optimum m hm = B → J.optimum m hm ≤ B → (∀ (j : Fin jobs₁), I.release j + B ≤ d) → (I.append J d).optimum m hm = B
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_eq

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (hm : 0 < m) (d : ℕ), I.optimum m hm ≤ (I.append J d).optimum m hm
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_ge_left

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (hm : 0 < m) (d : ℕ), J.optimum m hm ≤ (I.append J d).optimum m hm
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_ge_right

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (hm : 0 < m) {B d : ℕ},
  I.optimum m hm ≤ B → J.optimum m hm ≤ B → (∀ (j : Fin jobs₁), I.release j + B ≤ d) → (I.append J d).optimum m hm ≤ B
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_le

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d : ℕ),
  (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices₁), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) →
    (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices₂), J.edge u w → J.edge v w → u = v) →
      ∀ (u v w : Fin (vertices₁ + vertices₂)), (I.append J d).edge u w → (I.append J d).edge v w → u = v
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_outForest

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  t < d →
    ∀ {v : Fin (vertices₁ + vertices₂)},
      v ∈ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t → ∃ u, v = Fin.castAdd vertices₂ u ∧ u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_before

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (v : Fin vertices₁),
  Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v ∈ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t ↔ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_left

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  d ≤ t →
    ∀ (v : Fin vertices₂),
      Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v ∈ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t ↔
        v ∈ J.revealedVertices (Scheduling.shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_right

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ),
  t < d → ∀ (v : Fin vertices₂), Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v ∉ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_right_before

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m d : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {U : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (I.append J d).Valid m U → ∀ (v : Fin vertices₂), d ≤ U (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v)
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_right_time

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {m d : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {T : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    J.Valid m T → (∀ (v : Fin vertices₁), S v < d) → (I.append J d).Valid m (Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule S T d)
name: Scheduling.Instance.append_valid

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L a b : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → {v | a ≤ I.release (I.owner v) ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ b}.card ≤ m * (b + L - a)
name: Scheduling.Instance.arrival_work_bound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m s t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    s ≤ t →
      (I.remaining S t).card + (I.executedDuring S s t).card ≤
        (if s = 0 then 0 else (I.remaining S (s - 1)).card) +
          {v | s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t}.card
name: Scheduling.Instance.backlog_accounting

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.batchCount

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
name: Scheduling.Instance.batchRemaining

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → r ≤ t → (I.batchRemaining S r t).Nonempty → (I.partialSlots m S r t).card < L
name: Scheduling.Instance.batch_prefix_idle_lt

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → r ≤ t → (I.batchRemaining S r t).card ≤ m * (L - (I.partialSlots m S r t).card)
name: Scheduling.Instance.batch_remaining_work_bound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      I.BatchedArrivals L →
        I.Valid m S →
          I.IsFIFO m S →
            I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → ∀ (h : ℕ), (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card ≤ Nat.clog 2 L * (m * L)
name: Scheduling.Instance.batched_backlog_bound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (hm : 0 < m),
  0 < jobs →
    I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm) →
      I.Valid m S →
        I.IsFIFO m S →
          m * I.maxFlow S ≤
            min ((m * m + m - 1) * I.optimum m hm) (m * ((Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm))
name: Scheduling.Instance.batched_fifo_combined_bound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (hm : 0 < m),
  0 < jobs →
    I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm) →
      I.Valid m S → I.IsFIFO m S → I.maxFlow S ≤ (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm
name: Scheduling.Instance.batched_fifo_competitive

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      I.BatchedArrivals L →
        I.Valid m S → I.IsFIFO m S → I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → I.FlowBound S ((Nat.clog 2 L + 2) * L)
name: Scheduling.Instance.batched_fifo_flowBound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (position : Fin vertices → ℕ),
      (∀ (v : Fin vertices), position v < m * L) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
          I.FlowBound (fun v => Scheduling.batchedTime m L (↑(I.owner v)) (position v)) L
name: Scheduling.Instance.batched_flowBound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (position : Fin vertices → ℕ),
      (∀ (v : Fin vertices), position v < m * L) →
        (Function.Injective fun v => (I.owner v, position v)) →
          (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
            (∀ (u v : Fin vertices),
                I.edge u v →
                  position u < L ∧
                    if position v < L then position u < position v else (position u + 1) * (m - 1) ≤ position v - L) →
              I.Valid m fun v => Scheduling.batchedTime m L (↑(I.owner v)) (position v)
name: Scheduling.Instance.batched_valid

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
name: Scheduling.Instance.beforeArrival

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {L h r : ℕ},
  0 < L →
    I.BatchedArrivals L →
      r < h * L →
        (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card =
          {v | I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r ∧ h * L ≤ S v}.card +
            ∑ i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h with r < i * L, (I.batchRemaining S (i * L) (h * L)).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.beforeArrival_partition

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {L h : ℕ},
  0 < L →
    I.BatchedArrivals L →
      (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card = ∑ i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h, (I.batchRemaining S (i * L) (h * L)).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.beforeArrival_sum

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {s B t : ℕ} (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B),
  (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
    s ≤ t → t < I.failureTime hf → Scheduling.deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false
name: Scheduling.Instance.before_failure_not_visible

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → (L : ℕ) → 0 < L → Scheduling.Batching I L (I.batchCount L)
name: Scheduling.Instance.canonicalBatching

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices →
    (m : ℕ) → 0 < m → ℕ → (B : ℕ) → 0 < B → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ), t < s → {v | I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t} = {v | S v = t}
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_execution_prefix

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ), t ≤ s → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v < t ↔ S v < t
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_prefix_time

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ),
  s ≤ t →
    (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
      Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t} =
        Scheduling.publicCombined m fuel B s (I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s)) t
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_publicPolicy

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ),
  t ≤ s → I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) t = I.readyObservation S t
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_readyObservation

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s : ℕ),
  m ≤ 2 ^ fuel * B →
    B ≤ 2 * I.optimum m hm →
      B < 2 * m →
        I.Valid m S →
          (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
            (∀ (v : Fin vertices),
                S v < s → S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm)) →
              I.Valid m (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) ∧
                I.FlowBound (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) (352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm)) ∧
                  ∀ (v : Fin vertices), S v < s → I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = S v
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_spec

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (m : ℕ) → 0 < m → Scheduling.Assignment
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge]
  {otherJobs otherVertices m : ℕ} (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [inst_1 : DecidableRel J.edge]
  (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ u ≤ t, I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm) u = J.readyObservation (J.combinedSchedule m hm) u) →
    Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t} = Finset.image Fin.val {v | J.combinedSchedule m hm v = t}
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_nonclairvoyant

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ),
  Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t} =
    Scheduling.publicCombined m m 1 0 (I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm)) t
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  0 < jobs →
    I.Valid m (I.combinedSchedule m hm) ∧
      I.maxFlow (I.combinedSchedule m hm) ≤ 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm)
name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_spec

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → Fin jobs → ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.completion

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ (hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B),
      ∀ v ∈ I.survivors (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (I.failureTime hf),
        I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * (2 * B) ^ 2
name: Scheduling.Instance.doubled_phase_start

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) {L : ℕ},
  0 < L → ∀ (i : ℕ), I.epochWork S L i = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L), {v | S v = t}.card
name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_eq_sum

statement:

name: Scheduling.Instance.leftSchedule

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ d : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {U : Scheduling.Assignment} {B : ℕ},

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m d : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {U : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (I.append J d).Valid m U → I.Valid m (Scheduling.Instance.leftSchedule U)

statement: (ℕ → Prop) → ℕ → Finset ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds

statement:
∀ (mark : ℕ → Prop) (K : ℕ),
  (Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds mark (K + 1)).card =
    (Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds mark K).card + if mark K then 1 else 0
name: Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds_succ

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.maxFlow

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ d : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (U : Scheduling.Assignment),
  I.maxFlow (Scheduling.Instance.leftSchedule U) ≤ (I.append J d).maxFlow U
name: Scheduling.Instance.maxFlow_left_le

statement:
∀ {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ m d : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs₁ vertices₁)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) {U : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (I.append J d).Valid m U → J.maxFlow (Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule U d) ≤ (I.append J d).maxFlow U
name: Scheduling.Instance.maxFlow_right_le

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ),
  x ∈ (I.graphObservation done t).edges ↔
    ∃ u v, u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t ∧ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t ∧ I.edge u v ∧ (↑u, ↑v) = x
name: Scheduling.Instance.mem_graphObservation_edges

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t n : ℕ),
  n ∈ (I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix S t) t).ready ↔ ∃ v, I.Ready S t v ∧ ↑v = n
name: Scheduling.Instance.mem_graph_ready

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] (S : Scheduling.Assignment)
  (t : ℕ) (x : Lex (ℕ × ℕ)), x ∈ I.readyObservation S t ↔ ∃ v, I.Ready S t v ∧ I.fifoPriority v = x
name: Scheduling.Instance.mem_readyObservation

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s B : ℕ},
  ¬I.PhaseFails S s B →
    (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
      ∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
name: Scheduling.Instance.no_failure_flow

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {s B t : ℕ},
  ¬I.PhaseFails S s B →
    (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
      s ≤ t → Scheduling.deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false
name: Scheduling.Instance.no_failure_not_visible

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (m : ℕ) → 0 < m → ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.optimum

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  ∃ O, I.Valid m O ∧ I.FlowBound O (I.optimum m hm)
name: Scheduling.Instance.optimum_attained

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  ∃ O, I.Valid m O ∧ I.maxFlow O = I.optimum m hm
name: Scheduling.Instance.optimum_eq_minimum

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → I.optimum m hm ≤ L
name: Scheduling.Instance.optimum_le

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.optimum m hm ≤ I.maxFlow O
name: Scheduling.Instance.optimum_le_maxFlow

statement: ∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m), 0 < jobs → 0 < I.optimum m hm
name: Scheduling.Instance.optimum_pos

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.partialSlots

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  r ≤ t → (I.partialSlots m S r (t + 1)).card = (I.partialSlots m S r t).card + if I.PrefixFull m S r t then 0 else 1
name: Scheduling.Instance.partialSlots_succ

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O →
        ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (t : ℕ),
          I.release j ≤ t →
            ∀ (v : Fin vertices),
              I.owner v = j → t ≤ S v → I.release j + (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤ O v
name: Scheduling.Instance.partial_progress

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L t : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O →
        I.FlowBound O L →
          ∀ (j : Fin jobs),
            I.release j ≤ t → (∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ t ≤ S v) → (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card < L
name: Scheduling.Instance.partial_slots_lt

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L n : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O →
    I.FlowBound O L → ∀ (p : Fin (n + 1) → Fin vertices), (∀ (k : Fin n), I.edge (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) → n + 1 ≤ L
name: Scheduling.Instance.path_length_bound

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) →
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → ℕ → ℕ → Scheduling.Instance (Finset.image I.owner R).card R.card
name: Scheduling.Instance.phaseInstance

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O →
    I.FlowBound O L →
      ∀ (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ),
        (∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
          ∃ T, (I.phaseInstance R D s).Valid m T ∧ (I.phaseInstance R D s).FlowBound T L
name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_offline_bound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (R : Finset (Fin vertices))
  (D s : ℕ), (∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) → (I.phaseInstance R D s).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm
name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_optimum_le

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {D s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment),
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    ∀ [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] [inst_1 : DecidableRel (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge] (u : ℕ),
      Scheduling.renameObservation (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s))
          ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).readyObservation T u) =
        Scheduling.delayObservation D s (s + u) (I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) (s + u))
name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_readyObservation

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {D s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment),
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    ∀ (u : ℕ) (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card),
      (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Ready T u v ↔
        I.Ready (I.splice S s T) (s + u) (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) ∧
          I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v)) + D ≤ s + u
name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_ready_iff

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ) (v : Fin R.card),
  (I.phaseInstance R D s).release ((I.phaseInstance R D s).owner v) = I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex R v)) + D - s
name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_release_owner

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {R : Finset (Fin vertices)} {D s : ℕ},
  (∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    ∀ (j : Fin (Finset.image I.owner R).card), s ≤ (I.residualInstance R D).release j
name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_releases_after_start

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (position : Fin vertices → ℕ),
      (∀ (v : Fin vertices), position v < m * L) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
          I.FlowBound (fun v => Scheduling.pipelineTime m L (↑(I.owner v)) (position v)) (2 * L)
name: Scheduling.Instance.pipeline_flowBound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (position : Fin vertices → ℕ),
      (∀ (v : Fin vertices), position v < m * L) →
        (Function.Injective fun v => (I.owner v, position v)) →
          (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
            (∀ (u v : Fin vertices), I.edge u v → position u < L ∧ position u < position v) →
              I.Valid m fun v => Scheduling.pipelineTime m L (↑(I.owner v)) (position v)
name: Scheduling.Instance.pipeline_valid

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixService

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S → (I.prefixService S r t).card ≤ m
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixService_card_le

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (r t : ℕ),
  (I.prefixWork S r t).card = ∑ s ∈ Finset.Ico r t, (I.prefixService S r s).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork_card

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (r t : ℕ),
  (I.prefixWork S r t).card ≤ (I.remaining S r).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork_le_remaining

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {r t : ℕ},
  r ≤ t → {v | I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r ∧ t ≤ S v}.card + (I.prefixWork S r t).card = (I.remaining S r).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefix_conservation

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  m * (t - r) ≤ (I.prefixWork S r t).card + m * (I.partialSlots m S r t).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.prefix_full_work

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) →
    [DecidableRel I.edge] → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation
name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] [inst_1 : DecidableRel J.edge]
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix T t) t →
    I.readyObservation S t = J.readyObservation T t
name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S T : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {t : ℕ}, (∀ (v : Fin vertices), S v < t ↔ T v < t) → I.readyObservation S t = I.readyObservation T t
name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_prefix

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] [inst_1 : DecidableRel J.edge]
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix T t) t →
    I.readyObservation S t ⊆ J.readyObservation T t
name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S → ¬I.PrefixFull m S r t → ∀ {v : Fin vertices}, I.Ready S t v → I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r → S v = t
name: Scheduling.Instance.ready_processed_of_partial

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices
name: Scheduling.Instance.rebase

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
name: Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L s : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → (∀ (j : Fin jobs), s ≤ I.release j) → (I.rebase s).FlowBound (I.rebaseSchedule O s) L
name: Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule_flowBound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m s : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → (∀ (j : Fin jobs), s ≤ I.release j) → (I.rebase s).Valid m (I.rebaseSchedule O s)
name: Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule_valid

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L h : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      I.BatchedArrivals L →
        I.Valid m S →
          I.IsFIFO m S →
            I.Valid m O →
              I.FlowBound O L →
                (∀ j < h, (I.beforeArrival S (j * L)).card < (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card) →
                  (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).card ≤ Nat.clog 2 L
name: Scheduling.Instance.record_batch_count

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L h i : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      I.BatchedArrivals L →
        I.Valid m S →
          I.IsFIFO m S →
            I.Valid m O →
              I.FlowBound O L →
                (∀ j < h, (I.beforeArrival S (j * L)).card < (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card) →
                  i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h →
                    1 + ∑ j ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h with i < j, (I.partialSlots m S (j * L) (h * L)).card ≤
                      (I.partialSlots m S (i * L) (h * L)).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.record_prefix_idle

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < L → (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) → I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ (i : ℕ), (I.alive S (i * L)).card ≤ c
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_alive_card_le

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L i : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    0 < L →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), S v < (i + 1) * L → I.release (I.owner v) ≤ i * L
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_epoch_no_arrivals

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      0 < c →
        jobs = c * (m * L) →
          I.Valid m S →
            (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
                (I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ i < jobs, I.epochWork S L i < m * L) → c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_every_epoch_flow_lower

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      0 < c →
        jobs = c * (c * (m * L)) →
          I.Valid m S →
            (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
                (∀ k < c * (m * L), I.epochWork S L (c * k) < m * L) → c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_forcing_flow_lower

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    0 < L →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
        Scheduling.Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) jobs = {v | jobs * L ≤ S v}.card
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_idleBacklog_eq

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {W : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = W) → vertices = jobs * W
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_vertex_count

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  c ≤ jobs →
    0 < L →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
          I.FlowBound S (c * L) → {v | jobs * L ≤ S v}.card ≤ (c - 1) * (m * L)
name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_young_backlog

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
name: Scheduling.Instance.remaining

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L r : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → (I.remaining S r).card ≤ (I.beforeArrival S r).card + m * L
name: Scheduling.Instance.remaining_at_arrival

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {O S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → ∀ (t : ℕ), (I.remaining S t).card ≤ (I.alive S t).card * (m * L)
name: Scheduling.Instance.remaining_le_alive_work

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →

{jobs vertices : ℕ} →

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card),

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Finset (Fin vertices) → ℕ → ℕ
name: Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card),

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → Fin R.card → Fin (Finset.image I.owner R).card
name: Scheduling.Instance.residualOwner

statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → Scheduling.Assignment
name: Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {L : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.FlowBound O L →
    ∀ (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ), (I.residualInstance R D).FlowBound (I.residualSchedule R D O) L
name: Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule_flowBound

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → ∀ (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ), (I.residualInstance R D).Valid m (I.residualSchedule R D O)

statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → Fin R.card → Fin vertices

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  Function.Injective (I.residualVertex R)

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card),
  I.residualVertex R v ∈ R
name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_mem

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  StrictMono (I.residualVertex R)
name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_strictMono

statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s : ℕ} (v : Fin vertices)
  (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s), I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) (I.survivorIndex v hv) = v

                  (F.toInstance L).Valid m S →
                    F.KeyLast S →
                      (∀ (j : Fin jobs) (l : ℕ), (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ 2 * m) →
                        (∀ k < c * (m * L), F.NewLayersNarrow S L (c * k * L) (c * k * L + L / 2)) →

          r.stop ≤ work ∧
            A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key)) = r.time ∧
              ∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)),
                Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = r.owner →

  (∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤ A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))) →
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q),
      have I := P.toInstance L hw;
      have J := (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).toInstance L hw;
